close_reason: Added pub fn cert_is_ca(cert) -> Result<bool, DerError> to pkix-path; pkix-path-builder::cert_is_ca and pkix-revocation::crl::cert_is_ca_cert both became thin wrappers that map the opaque DerError to their crate-specific Error variant. OID_BASIC_CONSTRAINTS const removed from both downstream crates (now resolved via pkix-path).
description:
## Locations
- pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs:182-200 — fn cert_is_ca(cert: &Certificate) -> Result<bool>
- pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:738-754 — fn cert_is_ca_cert(cert: &Certificate) -> crate::Result<bool>

## Finding
Both crates implement essentially the same logic — 'does this Certificate have a BasicConstraints extension with cA=TRUE?' — with structurally identical code:

1. Look up the BasicConstraints extension by raw OID (2.5.29.19) in tbs_certificate.extensions.
2. If absent, Ok(false).
3. If present, BasicConstraints::from_der(...). On parse failure, typed error, propagate; on success, return bc.ca.

The only differences:
- Function name (cert_is_ca vs cert_is_ca_cert)
- Error variant returned on malformed BC (Error::MalformedIntermediate vs Error::MalformedCertificate)
- Ownership of the OID constant (each crate defines its own OID_BASIC_CONSTRAINTS)

## Why this matters
- Maintenance hazard: any change to BasicConstraints handling (e.g., x509-cert API change, additional defense-in-depth) must be made in two places. The pass-2 fix landed both parsers ('fail-closed alternative' wording in both) but left them as parallel implementations.
- Code review surface: future contributors will not know which to update or whether they should converge.
- Test isolation: each crate maintains its own test coverage for what is the same logic.

## Severity
P3 (idiom / DRY). Not a correctness issue today (both implementations agree), but the parallel maintenance burden is exactly the kind of latent inconsistency that surfaces only when one side is updated.

## Fix options
1. Add a public helper to pkix-path — e.g., pub fn cert_is_ca(cert: &Certificate) -> Result<bool, DerError> that returns the opaque DerError on malformed BC. Both pkix-path-builder and pkix-revocation/crl call it and .map_err to their own error variant. pkix-path already exposes names_match as a similar utility, so this is consistent.
2. Inline both with a shared comment pointing to the canonical RFC 5280 §4.2.1.9 reference. Cheaper in churn but does not solve the DRY.

Option 1 is the idiomatic Rust answer and fits the existing 'pkix-path is the foundation' architecture from AGENTS.md.

## Out of scope
Not a v0.2 blocker — the two implementations agree today. File for v0.3 cleanup.
title: (IDIOM) P3: cert_is_ca duplicated between pkix-path-builder and pkix-revocation/crl
